req.pt: Legion Fealty 1 (exige Rank 10 Evil): 50 Aeacus Empowered (matar o Ultra Aeacus 50 vezes), 300 Tethered Soul, 500 Darkened Essence em /shadowrealmpast e 1.000 Dracolich Contract.
req.en: Legion Fealty 1 (needs Rank 10 Evil): 50 Aeacus Empowered (kill Ultra Aeacus 50 times), 300 Tethered Soul, 500 Darkened Essence in /shadowrealmpast and 1,000 Dracolich Contract.

req.pt: Legion Fealty 2 (nível 80): 400 de cada uma de 10 Cohorts Conquered, 4.000 no total.
req.en: Legion Fealty 2 (level 80): 400 each of 10 Cohorts Conquered, 4,000 in total.

req.pt: Legion Fealty 3: 4.000 Legion Token, 300 Dage's Favor, 100 Dark Token e 30 Diamond Token of Dage.
req.en: Legion Fealty 3: 4,000 Legion Token, 300 Dage's Favor, 100 Dark Token and 30 Diamond Token of Dage.

req.pt: Legion Fealty 4: 10 Exalted Crown, 20 Revenant's Spellscroll e 6 Conquest Wreath.
req.en: Legion Fealty 4: 10 Exalted Crown, 20 Revenant's Spellscroll and 6 Conquest Wreath.

note.pt: Os gargalos são os 4.000 Legion Tokens e os 4.000 Cohorts. Para os tokens, veja o card Legion Token: Shogun Paragon em /fotia é o método rápido para a maioria; sem o pet, "First Class Entertainment" (Axeros, /legionarena: 120 tokens, Axeros' Brooch com 4% de drop no Legion Fiend Rider) e "Undead Champion Recruitment" em /dreadrock. Com a Legion Promotion, os 6 Daily Exercises (aba Diárias, Chefes) dão de 100 a 250 tokens cada por dia.
note.en: The bottlenecks are the 4,000 Legion Tokens and the 4,000 Cohorts. For tokens, see the Legion Token card: Shogun Paragon in /fotia is the fast method for most players; without the pet, "First Class Entertainment" (Axeros, /legionarena: 120 tokens, Axeros' Brooch at a 4% drop from Legion Fiend Rider) and "Undead Champion Recruitment" in /dreadrock. With the Legion Promotion, the 6 Daily Exercises (Dailies tab, Bosses) give 100 to 250 tokens each per day.

req.pt: Corrente de 10 quests do Kro'nar; a classe sai na nona (Hero's Heartbeat), no nível 75.
req.en: Chain of 10 Kro'nar quests; the class comes from the ninth (Hero's Heartbeat), at level 75.

req.pt: Burning Fates: 3.000 Fire Essence em /volcano, 100 Akriloth's Flametongue, 50 Immortal Embers e 50 Ashes from the Void Realm. Exige a Blade of Awe no inventário.
req.en: Burning Fates: 3,000 Fire Essence in /volcano, 100 Akriloth's Flametongue, 50 Immortal Embers and 50 Ashes from the Void Realm. Needs the Blade of Awe in your inventory.

req.pt: Dragon's Will: 300 Unyielding Slime em /moonlab e 20 de cada material de chefe.
req.en: Dragon's Will: 300 Unyielding Slime in /moonlab and 20 of each boss material.

req.pt: Confluence of Fates: 300 Cross-Dimensional Weapons e 100 Darkon's Receipt. Rend: 125 Epic Hydra Fang em /hydrachallenge.
req.en: Confluence of Fates: 300 Cross-Dimensional Weapons and 100 Darkon's Receipt. Rend: 125 Epic Hydra Fang in /hydrachallenge.

note.pt: É a mais longa em número de quests. Para a quest 8 você precisa já ter a Blade of Awe, que é outro farm demorado.
note.en: It is the longest by quest count. For quest 8 you must already own the Blade of Awe, which is another slow farm.

sn: AQW Wiki: Void Highlord Merge Shop

req.pt: Merge da classe: 15 Roentgenium of Nulgath, 1 Void Crystal A e 1 Void Crystal B.
req.en: Class merge: 15 Roentgenium of Nulgath, 1 Void Crystal A and 1 Void Crystal B.

req.pt: Void Crystal A: 200 Unidentified 10, 150 Gem of Nulgath, 200 Dark Crystal Shard e 200 Tainted Gem.
req.en: Void Crystal A: 200 Unidentified 10, 150 Gem of Nulgath, 200 Dark Crystal Shard and 200 Tainted Gem.

req.pt: Void Crystal B: 200 Diamond of Nulgath, 30 Blood Gem of the Archfiend, 15 Totem of Nulgath e 2 Elders' Blood.
req.en: Void Crystal B: 200 Diamond of Nulgath, 30 Blood Gem of the Archfiend, 15 Totem of Nulgath and 2 Elders' Blood.

note.pt: A wiki lista as quantidades, mas não diz de onde vem cada material.
note.en: The wiki lists the quantities but not where each material comes from.

req.pt: Merge em /museum com 5 relíquias lendárias e as Legendary Runes, com reputação Blade of Awe rank 6.
req.en: Merge in /museum with 5 legendary relics and the Legendary Runes, with Blade of Awe reputation rank 6.

req.pt: Legendary Runes: itens de quest com 0,1% de chance de drop, matando muitos Chaos Lords.
req.en: Legendary Runes: quest items with a 0.1% drop chance from killing many Chaos Lords.

note.pt: Fonte de 2016: confira se os números ainda valem. É a arma pedida na quest 8 da Dragon of Time.
note.en: 2016 source: check that the numbers still hold. It is the weapon required by the Dragon of Time quest 8.

req.pt: Em /underworld, leve 10.000 Legion Tokens ao Dage e faça o merge na armadura.
req.en: In /underworld, take 10,000 Legion Tokens to Dage and merge them into the armor.

note.pt: Fonte de 2016: confira se a quantidade mudou. Os Legion Tokens são os mesmos da Legion Revenant.
note.en: 2016 source: check whether the amount changed. The Legion Tokens are the same ones used for Legion Revenant.

req.pt: Merge no Dark Birthday Token Merge: 2.000 Legion Tokens, e nada mais.
req.en: Merge at the Dark Birthday Token Merge: 2,000 Legion Tokens and nothing else.

note.pt: O Dark Birthday é um local sazonal, então a disponibilidade pode ser limitada. Veja o card dos Legion Tokens para saber onde farmar.
note.en: Dark Birthday is a seasonal location, so availability may be limited. See the Legion Token card for where to farm them.

sn: AQW Wiki: Infinite Legion Dark Caster

req.pt: Só por merge, não é vendida: 2.000 Legion Tokens.
req.en: Merge only, it is not sold: 2,000 Legion Tokens.

req.pt: A wiki lista dois locais de merge, o Dark Birthday Token Merge e o Undead Legion Merge, sem dizer qual faz esta receita.
req.en: The wiki lists two merge locations, the Dark Birthday Token Merge and the Undead Legion Merge, without saying which one handles this recipe.

note.pt: Os locais são sazonais em parte, então confirme se estão abertos antes de farmar.
note.en: Some of the locations are seasonal, so check they are open before you farm.

req.pt: Merge em Dragon Town: 75 Enchanted Scale e 100 Dragon Claw.
req.en: Merge in Dragon Town: 75 Enchanted Scale and 100 Dragon Claw.

req.pt: Dragon Claw cai de Dracolichs em Dragon Town (Blood, Chaos, Deluge, Granite, Inferno e Tempest). A wiki não informa a taxa de drop.
req.en: Dragon Claw drops from Dracoliches in Dragon Town (Blood, Chaos, Deluge, Granite, Inferno and Tempest). The wiki does not give the drop rate.

req.pt: Enchanted Scale é recompensa da quest da classe, nas quests do Galanoth, e não cai de monstros.
req.en: Enchanted Scale is a reward from the class quest in Galanoth's quests and does not drop from monsters.

note.pt: O gargalo são os 100 Dragon Claws.
note.en: The bottleneck is the 100 Dragon Claws.

req.pt: Merge no Necro Tower: 1 NUE Necronomicon e 1 Creature Shard.
req.en: Merge at the Necro Tower: 1 NUE Necronomicon and 1 Creature Shard.

req.pt: NUE Necronomicon custa 999 gold na loja do Necromancer e exige DoomWood Rank 10.
req.en: NUE Necronomicon costs 999 gold at the Necromancer shop and needs DoomWood Rank 10.

req.pt: Creature Shard tem 5% de chance de drop de Creature Creation, em Chopping Maul.
req.en: Creature Shard has a 5% drop chance from Creature Creation, in Chopping Maul.

note.pt: Poucas unidades, mas a reputação DoomWood rank 10 e o drop de 5% seguram o ritmo.
note.en: Few units, but the DoomWood rank 10 reputation and the 5% drop set the pace.

req.pt: Corrente de 4 quests do Lae, em /hollowdeep (Eventhub): Draftless, Flow Stress, Heat Treatment e Counterblow.
req.en: Chain of 4 quests from Lae, in /hollowdeep (Eventhub): Draftless, Flow Stress, Heat Treatment and Counterblow.

req.pt: Draftless (nível 85): 100 Legion Tokens, 50 Undead Energy e 25 Hollow Soul. Dá 1 Soul Fragment. Exige Undead Champion (armadura) e o Lae's Hardcore Contract.
req.en: Draftless (level 85): 100 Legion Tokens, 50 Undead Energy and 25 Hollow Soul. Gives 1 Soul Fragment. Needs Undead Champion (armor) and Lae's Hardcore Contract.

req.pt: Flow Stress (nível 85): 1.000 Legion Tokens, 1 Soul Sand e 6 Soul Fragments. Dá 1 Lich King Fragment.
req.en: Flow Stress (level 85): 1,000 Legion Tokens, 1 Soul Sand and 6 Soul Fragments. Gives 1 Lich King Fragment.

req.pt: Heat Treatment (nível 85): 10.000 Legion Tokens, 1 Soul Essence, 24 Soul Fragments e 6 Lich King Fragments. Exige Ultimate Lich King (permanente) e o Ultimate Lich King Helm. Recompensa: a Hollowborn Lich King.
req.en: Heat Treatment (level 85): 10,000 Legion Tokens, 1 Soul Essence, 24 Soul Fragments and 6 Lich King Fragments. Needs Ultimate Lich King (permanent) and the Ultimate Lich King Helm. Reward: the Hollowborn Lich King.

note.pt: As quests são pequenas, mas se repetem muito. Só para esta armadura, 24 Soul Fragments e 6 Lich King Fragments obrigam a repetir Flow Stress 6 vezes e Draftless 60 vezes (6 × 6 + 24). Nenhuma das quests lista taxa de drop.
note.en: The quests are small, but they repeat a lot. For this armor alone, 24 Soul Fragments and 6 Lich King Fragments mean running Flow Stress 6 times and Draftless 60 times (6 × 6 + 24). None of the quests lists a drop rate.

req.pt: Vem da última quest da corrente, a Counterblow (nível 95), que dá o Altar of the Hollowborn Caladbolg (ACS). Antes dela é preciso ter feito a Heat Treatment.
req.en: It comes from the last quest in the chain, Counterblow (level 95), which gives the Altar of the Hollowborn Caladbolg (ACS). You must have done Heat Treatment before it.

req.pt: Counterblow: 4 Exalted Crown, 4 Revenant's Spellscroll, 4 Conquest Wreath, 3 Soul Essence, 36 Soul Fragments e 12 Lich King Fragments.
req.en: Counterblow: 4 Exalted Crown, 4 Revenant's Spellscroll, 4 Conquest Wreath, 3 Soul Essence, 36 Soul Fragments and 12 Lich King Fragments.

req.pt: Exalted Crown, Revenant's Spellscroll e Conquest Wreath são materiais da Legion Revenant (Legion Fealty 4). Veja o card dela.
req.en: Exalted Crown, Revenant's Spellscroll and Conquest Wreath are Legion Revenant materials (Legion Fealty 4). See its card.

req.pt: Também recompensa a Hollowborn Lich King's Pride, o Morph, a Soul Eater Blades e o Badge da página de personagem.
req.en: It also rewards Hollowborn Lich King's Pride, the Morph, Soul Eater Blades and the character page badge.

note.pt: É a parte mais cara: 12 Lich King Fragments pedem 12 Flow Stress e 108 Draftless só aqui (12 × 6 + 36). No total, a corrente soma 44.800 Legion Tokens. As notas de design chamam este item de altar, e a wiki não explica o que ele faz.
note.en: This is the most expensive part: 12 Lich King Fragments need 12 Flow Stress runs and 108 Draftless runs just here (12 × 6 + 36). The whole chain adds up to 44,800 Legion Tokens. The design notes call this item an altar, and the wiki does not explain what it does.

req.pt: Nível 80 e a história dos 13 Lords of Chaos completa. A quest da classe começa em /championdrakath.
req.en: Level 80 and the 13 Lords of Chaos story completed. The class quest starts at /championdrakath.

req.pt: Parallel Chaos Amulet: 20 Champion Drakath Insignias. A quest dá 5 insígnias e só pode ser feita 1 vez por semana (reset na sexta), então leva no mínimo um mês.
req.en: Parallel Chaos Amulet: 20 Champion Drakath Insignias. The quest gives 5 insignias and can be done once a week (resets Friday), so it takes at least a month.

req.pt: 1.300 Fragment of Mount Doomskull em /mountdoomskull, 1 Fragment of the Dragon em /chaoslord e 13 Fragment of the Queen em /transformation.
req.en: 1,300 Fragment of Mount Doomskull at /mountdoomskull, 1 Fragment of the Dragon at /chaoslord and 13 Fragment of the Queen at /transformation.

req.pt: 12 fragmentos de Lords, 1 de cada, vencendo cada Lord em seu mapa (Escherion, Vath, Kitsune, Wolfwing, Discordia, Ledgermayne, Tibicenas, Khasaanda, Iadoa, Lionfang, Alteon e Xiang).
req.en: 12 Lord fragments, 1 each, by defeating each Lord on their map (Escherion, Vath, Kitsune, Wolfwing, Discordia, Ledgermayne, Tibicenas, Khasaanda, Iadoa, Lionfang, Alteon and Xiang).

note.pt: O limite é o Amulet semanal, não o tempo de grind. Dá para fazer o resto do farm enquanto as semanas passam.
note.en: The limit is the weekly Amulet, not grind time. You can do the rest of the farm while the weeks pass.

req.pt: Rank 10 Yokai e a história de /darkally (inclui "Defeat the Underfiend"). A corrente começa na SoulForge do Dage, em /underworld.
req.en: Rank 10 Yokai and the /darkally story (includes "Defeat the Underfiend"). The chain starts at Dage's SoulForge, in /underworld.

req.pt: Passo 1: SoulForge Hammer, Shadow Katana Blade (15 Platinum Paragon Medal a 1m de gold cada, 108 Obsidian Rock, 15 Weapon Imprint, entre outros) e Yokai Sword Scroll (888 Perfect Orochi Scales, 600 Darkened Essence e 1 Oni Skull Charm).
req.en: Step 1: SoulForge Hammer, Shadow Katana Blade (15 Platinum Paragon Medal at 1m gold each, 108 Obsidian Rock, 15 Weapon Imprint, among others) and Yokai Sword Scroll (888 Perfect Orochi Scales, 600 Darkened Essence and 1 Oni Skull Charm).

req.pt: Passo 2, opção Legion: 17.500 Legion Tokens, 13 Sapphire Orb, 50 Aeacus Empowered e as classes SwordMaster (2.000 LTs) e Infinite Legion Dark Caster (2.000 LTs).
req.en: Step 2, Legion option: 17,500 Legion Tokens, 13 Sapphire Orb, 50 Aeacus Empowered and the SwordMaster (2,000 LTs) and Infinite Legion Dark Caster (2,000 LTs) classes.

req.pt: Passo 2, opção sem Legion: 1.000 Sword Scroll Fragment, 400 Legion Combat Trophy e 50 Technique Observed no PvP do Dage, mais 250 de cada uma de três reliquias de chefes e 100 Aeacus Empowered.
req.en: Step 2, non-Legion option: 1,000 Sword Scroll Fragment, 400 Legion Combat Trophy and 50 Technique Observed in Dage's PvP, plus 250 each of three boss relics and 100 Aeacus Empowered.

note.pt: Quem tem Legion segue o caminho mais curto, mas gasta 17.500 Legion Tokens, mais 2.000 para cada uma das duas classes se ainda não as tiver.
note.en: Legion members take the shorter path, but it costs 17,500 Legion Tokens, plus 2,000 for each of the two classes if you do not own them yet.

req.pt: Nível 85 e Rank 7 Fishing. As quests são do Mirror Drakath, em /battleoff, e só dá para fazer 1 por dia.
req.en: Level 85 and Rank 7 Fishing. The quests come from Mirror Drakath, at /battleoff, and you can only do 1 a day.

req.pt: São 10 quests (Heart of Servitude até The Final Challenge), então o mínimo é 10 dias, cada uma pedindo de 4 a 6 bosses ou drops de mapas diferentes.
req.en: There are 10 quests (Heart of Servitude to The Final Challenge), so the minimum is 10 days, each asking for 4 to 6 bosses or drops from different maps.

req.pt: Entre os itens estão 15 Chaoroot, 15 Chaotic War Essence, 45 Purified Raindrop, 50 de cada Suppressed (Drows, Undead, Horcs, Weavers) e 15 Weapon Imprint.
req.en: Items include 15 Chaoroot, 15 Chaotic War Essence, 45 Purified Raindrop, 50 each of the Suppressed items (Drows, Undead, Horcs, Weavers) and 15 Weapon Imprint.

req.pt: A última quest pede vencer o Champion of Chaos em /ultradrakath.
req.en: The last quest asks you to defeat the Champion of Chaos at /ultradrakath.

note.pt: Atalho: quem tem o 11th Anniversary Collection Chest pode pegar a classe nele e pular tudo.
note.en: Shortcut: if you own the 11th Anniversary Collection Chest you can claim the class from it and skip everything.

req.pt: Rank 10 Good e Rank 8 SpellCrafting, mais várias histórias (Lord of Chaos 13, Elfhame até Gaiazor, Lost Ruins War, Seraph, Citadel e outras). Quests em /darkthronehub.
req.en: Rank 10 Good and Rank 8 SpellCrafting, plus several storylines (Lord of Chaos 13, Elfhame to Gaiazor, Lost Ruins War, Seraph, Citadel and others). Quests at /darkthronehub.

req.pt: Sem member: 8 quests, cada uma com 3 a 7 itens de bosses de mapas diferentes. Inclui 1.000 Undead Energy, 200 Nightmare Kibble, 20 Feather of Paradise, 77 Shoelace of a Fallen Paladin e 25 de cada flor do passo Eden.
req.en: Non-member: 8 quests, each with 3 to 7 items from bosses on different maps. Includes 1,000 Undead Energy, 200 Nightmare Kibble, 20 Feather of Paradise, 77 Shoelace of a Fallen Paladin and 25 of each flower in the Eden step.

req.pt: Com member: exige Rank 10 Healer e Warrior, e as 3 primeiras quests são só comprar a classe Paladin. As quests 5 a 8 são iguais às dos não-members.
req.en: With membership: needs Rank 10 Healer and Warrior, and the first 3 quests are just buying the Paladin class. Quests 5 to 8 are the same as for non-members.

req.pt: A Pyromancer Artifact tem 3% de drop do Xan, em /xantown.
req.en: The Pyromancer Artifact has a 3% drop from Xan, at /xantown.

note.pt: A versão member é bem mais curta. A não-member pede também o passo 1 do farm da Blinding Light of Destiny.
note.en: The member version is much shorter. The non-member one also needs step 1 of the Blinding Light of Destiny farm.

req.pt: Nível 50 e Rank 10 Evil. Sem pagar AC: faça a quest "Void Promotion" com o Oblivion, em /tercessuinotlim, e troque o Abyssal Contract na loja ArchFiend Merge.
req.en: Level 50 and Rank 10 Evil. Without paying ACs: do the "Void Promotion" quest with Oblivion, at /tercessuinotlim, and trade the Abyssal Contract in the ArchFiend Merge shop.

req.pt: Reagentes: 3 Unidentified 13, Pink Star Diamond of Nulgath, Immortal Joe's Black Star (Mercutio, em /mercutio) e Dirtlicker Demoted (Dirtlicker, em /fiendshard).
req.en: Reagents: 3 Unidentified 13, Pink Star Diamond of Nulgath, Immortal Joe's Black Star (Mercutio, at /mercutio) and Dirtlicker Demoted (Dirtlicker, at /fiendshard).

req.pt: Abyssal Star: 200 Dark Crystal Shard, 300 Tainted Gem e 200 Gem of Nulgath.
req.en: Abyssal Star: 200 Dark Crystal Shard, 300 Tainted Gem and 200 Gem of Nulgath.

req.pt: Blood Star of the ArchFiend: 20 Blood Gem of the ArchFiend, 8 Totem of Nulgath, 2 Void Aura e 999 ArchFiend Favour. Gold Star of Avarice: quase 20 milhões de gold, segundo o guia.
req.en: Blood Star of the ArchFiend: 20 Blood Gem of the ArchFiend, 8 Totem of Nulgath, 2 Void Aura and 999 ArchFiend Favour. Gold Star of Avarice: almost 20 million gold, according to the guide.

note.pt: O guia avisa que a ArchFiend repete a Legendary ArchFiend, então quem já tem a Legendary não precisa dela.
note.en: The guide notes that ArchFiend duplicates Legendary ArchFiend, so if you own the Legendary one you do not need this one.

req.pt: Exige member ativo na hora de pegar. Depois a classe continua sua mesmo sem member.
req.en: Needs an active membership when you get it. The class stays yours after the membership ends.

req.pt: 12 Svelgr Fang, com cerca de 1% de drop do Svelgr the Destroyer, em /tachyon.
req.en: 12 Svelgr Fang, with about a 1% drop from Svelgr the Destroyer, at /tachyon.

req.pt: 72 Sands of Time (Chronorysa, em /portalwar) e 144 Wraith Wisps (Time Wraiths, em /portalmaze).
req.en: 72 Sands of Time (Chronorysa, at /portalwar) and 144 Wraith Wisps (Time Wraiths, at /portalmaze).

req.pt: Com a quest "Chrono Class Quest" você ganha Saeculum Gems; junte 12 na loja do Kairos, em /tachyon.
req.en: The "Chrono Class Quest" gives Saeculum Gems; collect 12 at Kairos' shop, at /tachyon.

note.pt: O gargalo é o drop de 1% das 12 Svelgr Fang.
note.en: The bottleneck is the 1% drop of the 12 Svelgr Fang.

req.pt: Pré-requisitos: quests do Hs'Sakar (/firestorm), 3 primeiras do As'iiur (/airstorm) e do Murray (/citadel). O guia recomenda ter 10 ou mais espaços de inventário livres.
req.en: Prerequisites: Hs'Sakar's quests (/firestorm), the first 3 from As'iiur (/airstorm) and Murray's (/citadel). The guide recommends 10 or more free inventory slots.

req.pt: 10.500 Spirit Orbs, vindos das quests "Essential Essences" e "Bust some Dust" do Artix (/necropolis), ou da "Soul Searching" da Yara. Elas se juntam em 105 Loyal Spirit Orbs e 2 Bright Auras.
req.en: 10,500 Spirit Orbs, from Artix's "Essential Essences" and "Bust some Dust" quests (/necropolis), or Yara's "Soul Searching". They merge into 105 Loyal Spirit Orbs and 2 Bright Auras.

req.pt: Três metais (Celestial Copper, Blessed Barium e Sanctified Silver) pela quest diária "Mine Crafting" e por upgrades. Depois kits de arma: 3 Basic, 3 Advanced e 4 Ultimate, cada um pedindo bosses de dezenas de mapas.
req.en: Three metals (Celestial Copper, Blessed Barium and Sanctified Silver) from the daily "Mine Crafting" quest and upgrades. Then weapon kits: 3 Basic, 3 Advanced and 4 Ultimate, each asking for bosses on dozens of maps.

req.pt: Quest final: 250 Loyal Spirit Orb, 500 Spirit Orb, 125 Bright Aura, 75 Brilliant Aura, 1 Blinding Aura e 1 Ultimate Weapon Kit. Você junta os fragmentos com as Blinding Mace, Bow e Blade (10, 25 e 75 quests).
req.en: Final quest: 250 Loyal Spirit Orb, 500 Spirit Orb, 125 Bright Aura, 75 Brilliant Aura, 1 Blinding Aura and 1 Ultimate Weapon Kit. You gather the fragments with the Blinding Mace, Bow and Blade (10, 25 and 75 quests).

note.pt: A Blinding Aura tem 1% de drop. Para não depender dela, o guia manda juntar a Blinding Scythe of Destiny, que dá 100%. A BLoD dá 75% de dano extra contra Undead.
note.en: The Blinding Aura has a 1% drop. To avoid relying on it, the guide has you merge the Blinding Scythe of Destiny, which gives 100%. The BLoD gives 75% extra damage to Undead.

req.pt: Nível 60, rank 10 em DoomWood e o passo 1 da BLoD feito, mais as quests de /maul até /necrotower, até a Sally.
req.en: Level 60, DoomWood rank 10 and step 1 of the BLoD done, plus the quests from /maul to /necrotower, up to Sally.

req.pt: 7.500 Void Aura, 1.600 Cavern Celestite, 5.100 Bone Dust, 10.000 Undead Energy, 4 Barium e 31 Chaorrupted Hourglass.
req.en: 7,500 Void Aura, 1,600 Cavern Celestite, 5,100 Bone Dust, 10,000 Undead Energy, 4 Barium and 31 Chaorrupted Hourglass.

req.pt: Drops raros: Blade Essence x2 (cerca de 1%, Chaorrupted Armour em /chaoscrypt), Scroll of Dark Arts x4 (cerca de 1%, Ultra Vordred) e Doom Heart (cerca de 0,5%, Ultra Sepulchure).
req.en: Rare drops: Blade Essence x2 (about 1%, Chaorrupted Armour at /chaoscrypt), Scroll of Dark Arts x4 (about 1%, Ultra Vordred) and Doom Heart (about 0.5%, Ultra Sepulchure).

req.pt: Chaorrupted Hourglass cai a cerca de 20% do Chaos Lord Iadoa, em /timespace. Também precisa de Necromancer Rank 10 e 2 Primarch's Hilt.
req.en: Chaorrupted Hourglass drops at about 20% from Chaos Lord Iadoa, at /timespace. You also need Necromancer Rank 10 and 2 Primarch's Hilt.

note.pt: O guia recomenda ter a Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armour antes, porque ela facilita muito o farm de Void Aura. Dá 51% de dano extra em All.
note.en: The guide recommends having Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armour first, since it makes the Void Aura farm much easier. It gives 51% extra damage to All.

req.pt: Exige member, Rank 5 Evil e a história do Nukemichi (/akiba e /bludrut a /bludrut3). Quests do Vayle, em /necropolis.
req.en: Needs membership, Rank 5 Evil and Nukemichi's storyline (/akiba and /bludrut to /bludrut3). Quests from Vayle, at /necropolis.

req.pt: 10.500 Dark Spirit Orbs, que se juntam em 105 Corrupt Spirit Orbs e 2 Ominous Auras. Também pede DoomKnight Rank 10, que exige Warrior e Healer no 10.
req.en: 10,500 Dark Spirit Orbs, which merge into 105 Corrupt Spirit Orbs and 2 Ominous Auras. It also needs DoomKnight Rank 10, which needs Warrior and Healer at 10.

req.pt: Três metais (Accursed Arsenic, Calamitous Chromium e Reprehensible Rhodium) da quest diária "Hard Core Metals", cada um com upgrade de 26 Dark Energy, 5 Dark Spirit Orbs e 16 Deadly Knightshade.
req.en: Three metals (Accursed Arsenic, Calamitous Chromium and Reprehensible Rhodium) from the daily "Hard Core Metals" quest, each upgraded with 26 Dark Energy, 5 Dark Spirit Orbs and 16 Deadly Knightshade.

req.pt: Kits de arma: 3 DoomSquire, 3 DoomSoldier e 4 DoomKnight. Quest final: 250 Corrupt Spirit Orb, 500 Dark Spirit Orb, 125 Ominous Aura, 75 Diabolical Aura e 1 Doom Aura.
req.en: Weapon kits: 3 DoomSquire, 3 DoomSoldier and 4 DoomKnight. Final quest: 250 Corrupt Spirit Orb, 500 Dark Spirit Orb, 125 Ominous Aura, 75 Diabolical Aura and 1 Doom Aura.

note.pt: A Doom Aura tem 1% de drop, ou 100% com a Necrotic Scythe of Scourge. Dá 51% de dano extra em Humans e é o pré-requisito de outros farms.
note.en: The Doom Aura has a 1% drop, or 100% with the Necrotic Scythe of Scourge. It gives 51% extra damage to Humans and is a prerequisite for other farms.

req.pt: Rank 10 Evil, Rank 7 Arcangrove e 1 Unidentified 13 para aceitar cada quest. Todas saem do Oblivion, em /tercessuinotlim. A página do guia não escreve o nome do item final, mas a URL e a última quest apontam para esta armadura.
req.en: Rank 10 Evil, Rank 7 Arcangrove and 1 Unidentified 13 to accept each quest. All come from Oblivion, at /tercessuinotlim. The guide page does not write the final item's name, but the URL and the last quest point to this armor.

req.pt: "Willpower Extraction": repetir até ter 44 Unidentified 34. Pede 5 Necrot, 5 Chaoroot, 5 Doomatter, 10 Essence of Nulgath, 50 ArchFiend's Favour e mais itens avulsos.
req.en: "Willpower Extraction": repeat until you have 44 Unidentified 34. Asks for 5 Necrot, 5 Chaoroot, 5 Doomatter, 10 Essence of Nulgath, 50 ArchFiend's Favour and other single items.
